verdict.rationale: The pack documents generic email event notifications and a 7-day raw export of transactional events, but never names bounces, complaints, or blocklist signals per send. It also shows no deliverability monitoring or guidance when deliverability degrades. Generic event data is adjacent at best and does not show this story's capability.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades
